title: ResonanceDetector — persistence, harmonic rejection using PitchDetector f0, scoring
description:
Implement ResonanceDetector on top of SpectralAnalysisEngine snapshots: local baseline excess, persistence analysis, candidate scoring, and musical-harmonic rejection using PitchDetector f0 per SHREDEQ_SPEC.md §8.2–8.4 and §21.6.

STRICT FILE SCOPE: Create or modify ONLY the files listed in this task's allowed_write_paths.

Before editing, inspect:
- .abracapocus/SHREDEQ_SPEC.md §8.2–8.4 (baseline B_t, excess E_t, persistence P_t, score R_t, harmonic rejection with f0)
- .abracapocus/SHREDEQ_SPEC.md §21.6 (fixtures intent: fixed resonances vs moving harmonics; never modifies sound; bounded recommendations)
- Source/Analysis/SpectralAnalysisEngine.h snapshot / bin APIs from g.1 (read only)
- Source/DSP/PitchDetector.h getFrequencyHz/getConfidence/TrackingState from phase F (read only; consume f0 snapshot only)
- Source/DSP/* prepare/reset style (read only)
- CMakeLists.txt (read only; g.3 owns registration)

Implement Source/DSP/ResonanceDetector.h and Source/DSP/ResonanceDetector.cpp:
1. ResonanceDetector with prepare(sampleRate, fftSizeOrMaxBins), reset(), setEnabled, and processControlRate / analyzeSnapshot that consumes a SpectralAnalysisEngine spectrum snapshot (log-magnitude S_t[k]) — analysis-thread/control-rate only, not processBlock DSP audio mutation.
2. Local spectral baseline via octave- or ERB-domain smoothing: B_t[k] = smooth_broad(S_t[k]); excess E_t[k] = S_t[k] - B_t[k] per §8.2.
3. Persistence: P_t[k] = lambda * P_{t-1}[k] + (1-lambda) * indicator(E_t[k] > theta) with configurable lambda and theta; fixed-size P buffer allocated at prepare.
4. Candidate score R_t[k] combining excess, persistence, narrowness N_t[k], perceptual weight W[k], and frequency stability F_t[k] per §8.3. Document how N/W/F are computed (e.g. local peak sharpness, A-weight-ish or guitar-band weights, frame-to-frame bin stability).
5. Musical-harmonic rejection per §8.4: accept latest f0 Hz + confidence from PitchDetector (passed in, not owned). Lower candidate confidence when f_candidate ≈ m * f0 for integer m (reasonable harmonic range, e.g. 1–16) and/or when the peak tracks f0 motion across frames. Fixed peaks present across different notes receive higher cab-resonance confidence than peaks that follow harmonics. When f0 confidence is low, do not over-penalize (document fallback).
6. Emit a bounded list of ResonanceCandidate cards (fixed max, e.g. top 8–16): center frequency Hz, bandwidth/Q hint, excess dB, persistence, confidence, classification hints (e.g. PersistentCabinet, IntermittentFizzCluster, BoxResonance, NoteLinkedLowerConfidence). Never apply audio processing — detection only.
7. Scan-session helpers usable by g.3: beginScan/endScan or accumulate-for-duration flags that freeze/summary candidates over a scan window without unbounded growth.
8. Guards: finite scores, clamp frequencies to sensible guitar/bass diagnostic range (e.g. ~150 Hz–16 kHz for suppressor-aligned candidates), valid bin indices after sample-rate/FFT changes via prepare/reset.
9. No ResonanceSuppressor filters, no PluginProcessor, no tests, no CMakeLists, no SpectralAnalysisEngine rewrites beyond reading its public snapshot API.
